args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~0.18). Action taken: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (completed us-east only, orchestrator halted the rollout); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback health check confirms all regions on v2.3.0 and healthy, error rate down to ~0.002. v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should not be redeployed without a fix.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was created despite the timeout (INC-0001, SEV2, open) — no duplicate was needed.

**Summary of actions:**

1. **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback:** Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt was a partial failure — it completed us-east but the orchestrator halted before the other regions. A retry completed us-west and eu-west, so all regions are now on v2.3.0.

3. **Verification:** Post-rollback status shows the service healthy in all regions with the error rate down to ~0.2%.

4. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), and the verification. On-call has been paged. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is fixed.
